name: max_eig_path_16
description: 16x16 SDP: max <C,X> s.t. tr(X)=1, X 16x16 PSD, C = tridiagonal Toeplitz T_16(2,1) (diagonal 2, off-diagonal 1). By the variational formula opt = lambda_max(C) = 2 + 2 cos(pi/17). Optimal X* is the rank-1 projector onto the top eigenvector (singular, boundary optimum). Scalable size-stress family (n=4,8,16).
reference_method: Closed form lambda_max(T_n(2,1)) = 2 + 2 cos(pi/(n+1)); n=16. Cross-checked in mpmath 1.3.0 and sympy 1.14.0 against an explicit symmetric eigensolve to >60 digits.
